summary: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of 100% of Super International Trading Limited, a Hong Kong company trading large-scale industrial equipment, for undisclosed terms. The acquisition closed on May 27, 2026, pursuant to a Share Transfer Agreement with Leyan Yang dated April 16, 2026. Super became a wholly owned subsidiary. No board recommendation, advisor, or financial details were disclosed. What to watch: future integration disclosures and any earn-out or contingent consideration; risk-arb is moot as deal is closed.
